description: This Java class 'Histograms' provides functionality for collecting, managing, and reporting statistical histograms and performance metrics, including methods for adding data, snapshotting, and formatting statistics for logging.

classes.name: Histograms
classes.description: Main class for managing histograms and performance statistics.

classes.name: Histograms.Statistics
classes.description: Represents performance statistics for a single operation.

classes.name: Histograms.StatisticsGroup
classes.description: Groups statistics of the same type.

classes.name: Histograms.ValueType
classes.description: Enumerates types of values, e.g., INVOCATION.

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Updates totals and resets snapshot, returning formatted statistics.

methods.name: getCurrentStatistics
methods.description: Returns current histogram statistics without resetting.

methods.name: sortAndAddTimes
methods.description: Sorts statistics groups and adds timing info.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns histogram index for a given value.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a sample value to the statistics.

methods.name: getCurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns current statistics snapshot without reset.

methods.name: mergeStats
methods.description: Merges source statistics into a snapshot.

methods.name: sortStatistics
methods.description: Sorts statistics within a group for logging.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a string buffer.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Appends header info for statistics group.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats a statistics group into a string.
